 US Central Command (CENTCOM) says two Iranian drones launched towards Bahrain shot down, with no injuries or damage. CENTCOM also denied IRGC claims that it had attacked a US “early-warning radar” in Bahrain earlier in the day.
 The ⁠International Atomic ⁠Energy Agency says it is “ increasingly concerned ” about an ⁠underground uranium-enrichment plant at Isfahan that Tehran has not let it inspect since the US attack on the area in June 2025.
